briefdescription.para: RuntimeDyldMachOTarget - Templated base class for generic MachO linker algorithms and data structures.

detaileddescription.para: Concrete, target specific sub-classes can be accessed via the impl() methods. (i.e. the RuntimeDyldMachO hierarchy uses the Curiously Recurring Template Idiom). Concrete subclasses for each target can be found in ./Targets.
